cohort: The study included 144 pregnant women diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and 52 normal control pregnant women.
finding: Moderate and high levels of Stearic acid (C18:0) in the second trimester were negatively associated with the occurrence of adverse pregnancy outcomes (APO) in pregnant women with GDM, and C18:0 showed predictive value for APO.
mod_finding: Moderate and high levels of Stearic acid (C18:0) were negatively associated with adverse pregnancy outcomes, which included emergency cesarean section.
